script.title: 天平平衡法解一元一次方程

scenes.title: 天平初现，等式平衡
scenes.narration: 解方程就像维护一架天平。左边放着未知数与常数，右边也有对应的重量。要让天平保持平衡，两边必须同时做相同的操作。
scenes.subtitle: 天平代表等号，左右重量相等

scenes.title: 移项原理，同减消去
scenes.narration: 想把未知数集中到左边，就像从两边同时拿走相同重量的砝码。等式右边减去二倍x后，左边也要同步减去二倍x。
scenes.subtitle: 两边同减二倍x，天平仍平衡

scenes.title: 常数换位，符号翻转
scenes.narration: 同样地，把右边的常数移到左边，相当于两边同时减去该常数。跨过等号时，正负号会自然翻转，保持整体平衡。
scenes.subtitle: 常数跨等号，正负要变反

scenes.title: 整理化简，自主挑战
scenes.narration: 经过同加同减的操作，方程已变得简洁。现在请你尝试用天平平衡的思路，独立完成下一道题目，记住每一步都要保持左右相等哦。
scenes.subtitle: 方法掌握后，请独立练习

actual_renderer_evidence.source: 规则/代码检查：scripts/microcourse_animation.py::context_swap，非新模型观察
actual_renderer_evidence.implementation:
def context_swap(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, progress: float, scene_index: int):
    centered(draw, (960, 350), "两组同样的礼盒，怎样保持公平？", 29, MUTED)
    left, right = (460, 552), (1420, 552)
    for side, center, count, coupons in [("left", left, 3, "-7"), ("right", right, 2, "+4")]:
        draw.rounded_rectangle((center[0]-300, 410, center[0]+300, 741), radius=2, outline=BORDER, width=1)
        centered(draw, (center[0], 447), "左边" if side == "left" else "右边", 26, MUTED)
        for idx in range(count):
            bx = center[0]-160+idx*130
            faded = scene_index >= 1 and idx < 2 and progress > .36
            draw.rounded_rectangle((bx-48, 500, bx+48, 585), radius=2, fill=BG, outline=BORDER if faded else TEAL, width=2)
            centered(draw, (bx, 542), "x", 34, MUTED if faded else TEAL)
            if faded:
                draw.line((bx-34, 514, bx+34, 571), fill=MUTED, width=4)
        if scene_index < 2 or side == "right":
            tile(draw, (center[0], 663), coupons, PINK, 170, 62)
    centered(draw, (960, 550), "=", 74)
    if scene_index == 0:
        centered(draw, (960, 800), "3x - 7 = 2x + 4", 43)
    elif scene_index == 1:
        centered(draw, (960, 796), "两边同时减去 2x", 34, TEAL)
        for x in (460, 1420):
            arrow(draw, (x, 726), (x, 760), TEAL, amount=ease(progress*2))
    else:
        # A term's location and sign are coupled to one shared crossing progress.
        u = ease(progress / .82)
        start, end = (460, 663), (1600, 663)
        moving = (start[0]+(end[0]-start[0])*u, start[1]-230*math.sin(math.pi*u))
        sign = "-7" if moving[0] < 960 else "+7"
        tile(draw, moving, sign, PINK, 170, 62)
        arrow(draw, (635, 790), (1260, 790), PINK, amount=u)
        centered(draw, (960, 828), "两边同加七，换边后的符号改变", 29, MUTED)
